spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the explainer's compatibility section exactly: hidden remains a trapping 2D container, clip propagates once single-axis containers exist, and start-none is the per-axis opt-out.

interactive.rationale: Live computed-value inspector over four overflow pairs, a side-by-side measured trap test, and a toggle that applies the real start-none declaration to the clip lane.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the coercion inspector, side-by-side scrollers, and the opt-out; all three are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: This page IS the edge/migration angle: legacy coercion, post-157 divergence, opt-out-active expectations, and an unexpected-propagation warning for the hidden rig each get distinct verdict text.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5086608215900160 and the explainer's Compatibility section.

conformance.rationale: The suite's clip-preserved, propagation, and hidden-still-traps assertions encode this page's three contracts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (cloud fallback, no chrome-devtools-mcp): inspector showed auto+clip and clip+auto coerced, auto+hidden and clip+clip kept; both rigs measured trapped at 113 (edge 150) before and after the opt-out toggle; CSS.supports('scroll-snap-align','start none')===true; zero console errors; both viewports screenshotted.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the inspector ran, the pair-syntax probe result, the full measured comparison payload, and the hidden-never-propagates invariant.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; kept/coerced verdict colours are the AAA dark tokens on paper; buttons meet 44px and aria-pressed state is outline-based.

accessibility.rationale: Scrollers focusable with labelled groups, table has caption and scopes, toggle exposes aria-pressed, readout is role=status aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: zero document overflow, rigs stack to one column on mobile, identical measured results.

openQuestions.title: Measure the divergence on a 157+ engine
openQuestions.detail: On a Chromium with the feature active, the clip rig should propagate (settle 150) while hidden stays at 113, and the start-none opt-out should restore trapping on the clip rig. Capture those three measurements to complete the matrix this page reports.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel toggle buttons no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Fix overflow at the source: grid items need min-width:0, and long unbreakable tokens need overflow-wrap handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .rig > div { min-width:0 } and overflow-wrap:anywhere on the note carrying the long flag token; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: scroll snap carousel accessible keyboard scrolling
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native settle signals over scroll polling for snap state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The measured check reads back the settled scrollTop after a fixed settle window rather than polling scroll events, mirroring the conformance assertions so page and suite agree.

summary: The compat/migration story measured live: four overflow pairs inspected via getComputedStyle, clip and hidden rigs probed side by side (both honestly trapped at 113 on Chromium 141), and the start-none opt-out applied as a real declaration. Cloud headless verification, both viewports clean.
